meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 对代码库进行9个维度的技术债务审计，使用AST-grep、grep、语言原生工具和可选的CodeGraph知识图谱，生成包含严重性、工作量估计和优先级排序的TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求代码库健康检查、技术债务审计、架构审查、代码质量评估或清理规划时触发，例如提到“tech debt”“code health”等关键词。

howto.what_en: Audits a codebase across 9 dimensions of technical debt using AST-grep, grep, native language tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces a TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes, all file-cited.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning—e.g., mentioning 'tech debt', 'code health', etc.

say_en.text: Audit the technical debt of this project
Evaluate codebase health and generate a report
